features.name: Portal Domain Spells
features.description:
| Cleric Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | adjust position, expeditious retreat |
| 3rd | glyph of shifting, misty step |
| 5th | dimensional shove, portal jaunt |
| 7th | dimension door, reposition |
| 9th | pierce the veil, teleportation circle |

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor, Arcana, and either cartographer's tools or navigator's tools (your choice).

choices.name: Portal Domain Tool
choices.description: Choose cartographer's tools or navigator's tools.

features.name: Portal Magic
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you gain access to liminal spells as cleric spells, even if not on the cleric list. These include: *bardo*, *devouring darkness*, *door of the far traveler*, *ethereal stairs*, *hypnagogia*, *hypnic jerk*, *mind maze*, *mirror realm*, *pierce the veil*, *reciprocating portal*, *rive*, *subliminal aversion*, and *threshold slip*.

features.name: Portal Bond
features.description:
At 1st level, at the end of a short or long rest, touch one willing creature to create a magical bond. While bonded, you know their direction (not exact location) on the same plane. As an action: teleport the bonded creature to within 5 ft of you (within prof bonus miles), or teleport yourself to within 5 ft of them.

Teleport use: 1/long rest. One bonded creature at a time; new bond ends the old.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Dimensional Shift
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, as an action, teleport a willing creature you can see (other than yourself) to an unoccupied space within 30 ft of you that you can see. At 10th level, you can target an unwilling creature (WIS save to resist).

features.name: Portal Touch
features.description:
At 6th level, as a bonus action, create a small portal in a space within 30 ft for 1 minute. When you cast a cleric touch spell, you can touch any creature within your reach or within 5 ft of the portal. Use bonus action each turn to move the portal up to 30 ft (must remain within 30 ft of you). One portal at a time.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Portal Touch
payload.description: Create a small portal within 30 ft for 1 min. Deliver touch spells through it. Move portal 30 ft as bonus action each turn.

features.name: Transpositional Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, open a brief portal near the target or another creature within 30 ft: that creature takes 1d8 damage of your weapon's type. At 14th level, choose two creatures (1d8 each) or one creature (2d8).

features.name: Portal Mastery
features.description: At 17th level, as a reaction when you see a creature use a magical gateway, teleport, or cast a teleportation spell, you can reroute the effect to an unoccupied space of your choice within 100 ft you can see. 1/long rest (or expend a 5th level+ spell slot to reuse).

payload.name: Portal Mastery
payload.description: When a creature uses a teleportation effect, reroute it to an unoccupied space within 100 ft you can see.
